# FDG3014

> DO NOT use abbreviations or contractions as part of identifier names.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.2.2 Using Abbreviations and Acronyms.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

## From the book

For example, use `GetWindow` rather than `GetWin`.
